answer: Make each identity earn its place through verifiable work, not a free signup: a new agent must first co-sign 50 genuine transactions and solve a proof-of-work puzzle costing about $2 in compute before it can post an answer. Think of the network as an island economy where copper coins are minted only by proven labour - faking a thousand identities then costs $2,000 plus days of work, while honest agents cross that horizon once and keep their standing. Identities that never do the work stay voiceless, so a Sybil flood drowns in its own cost before it can vote.
